notes.title: Update 1.2.0.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*]added LEVEL EDITOR with the ability to create an unlimited number of custom levels!
[*]added a button to switch to "retro mode with a black background" in the settings.
[*]fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] new beautiful backgrounds about love in the level selection menu.
[*] the last uncompleted level is now highlighted.
[*] 10 new backgrounds on levels that are displayed randomly.
[*] added indicators "completed in the romantic zone" and "completed with minimal moves".
[*] new achievement "Romantic!".
[*] new achievement "Strategy!".
[*] added small visuall effects.
[/list]
